008package paint.shared.constants;
009
010/**
011 * Centralizes the naming conventions for all primary data files used within the PAINT
012 * application.
013 * <p>
014 * The {@code PaintFileNames} class defines constants for CSV files (Recordings, Squares,
015 * Tracks), configuration JSONs, and other standard outputs produced or consumed by the
016 * pipeline modules.
017 * </p>
018 */
019public final class PaintFileNames {
020
021    private PaintFileNames() {
022        // Prevent instantiation
023    }
024
025    /** Standard name for the recordings metadata CSV file. */
026    public static final String RECORDINGS_CSV                 = "Recordings.csv";
027    /** Standard name for the tracks data CSV file. */
028    public static final String TRACKS_CSV                     = "Tracks.csv";
029    /** Standard name for the squares analysis results CSV file. */
030    public static final String SQUARES_CSV                    = "Squares.csv";
031    /** Standard name for the experiment-level info metadata CSV file. */
032    public static final String EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV            = "Experiment Info.csv";
033    /** Default filename for the primary project configuration JSON. */
034    public static final String PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON       = "Paint Configuration.json";
035    /** Default filename for the parameter sweep configuration JSON. */
036    public static final String PAINT_SWEEP_CONFIGURATION_JSON = "Paint Sweep Configuration.json";
037}
